thread:
metrics-bot: ALERT: console rollup row count drop for tenant `acme-corp` between 2025-07-15T11:00Z and 2025-07-15T15:00Z. hourly_rollups ingestion < 10% of normal.

Emma: Customer ticket #12345 — console shows blank usage heatmap and 'no data' on daily widget since ~11:30. Customer says their app sent requests. Can someone triage?

Priya: tagging ingest team. Do we have the tenant id / example request?

Emma: tenant: `acme-corp` (org_789). Example API request from support logs: 
```
POST /v1/usage/events
Authorization: Bearer <redacted>
{ "tenant": "acme-corp", "features": ["text-gen"], "tokens": 120 }
```
Customer provided event timestamps in logs around `2025-07-15T11:18:02Z` and `2025-07-15T14:02:11Z`.

Raj: quick check of Kafka consumer groups — consumer `usage-rollup-consumer` shows high lag for partition 12 since 11:05. Lag graph snapshot: `lag ~ 120k messages -> 0` then resumed at 15:10. Looks like consumer crashed and auto-rebalanced.

Jordan: I saw an unexpected backfill job kicked at 11:00 by the daily-repair pipeline (probably cron). That job attempted to write to `hourly_rollups` and failed repeatedly. From the backfill pod logs: 
```
2025-07-15T11:02:18Z ERROR backfill-worker: write failed: HTTP 401 from billing-service when verifying tenant quota
2025-07-15T11:02:18Z WARN backfill-worker: retrying (5/5)
2025-07-15T11:02:18Z ERROR backfill-worker: giving up, exiting
```

Priya: 401 from billing-service? We didn't change auth tokens for the pipeline. Who rotated the service account?

DevOpsBot: deploy-bot: service-account `backfill-sa` rotated at 2025-07-15T10:59:55Z by infra/keys-rotation-job.

Priya: ah — keys rotation happened right before the cron. Possible race: rotation completed but backfill pipeline didn't pick up new secret.

Emma: Customer-side they see requests accepted by API (200) but console aggregations missing — that fits with worker failing to write to rollups.

Raj: Repro steps I ran locally:
1) bootstrap consumer group from offset X
2) start backfill worker with old `backfill-sa` secret (expired)
3) observe `401` from billing-service on first write
4) worker exits, leaving messages unprocessed => dashboard gap

Jordan: Confirmed. I re-ran backfill with the updated secret and it progressed. Quick fix: restart backfill workers with fresh secret; they should pick up and drain the backlog.

Priya: I'll restart the daily-repair backfill workers in canary first. ETA 10m.

Emma: Notifying customer that we're investigating and will backfill missing hours — ETA for visible metrics?

Jordan: estimate: backlog ~ 2.3M events for acme-corp. With current throughput the backfill will take ~2.5–3 hours to fully repopulate the hourly rollups. Partial rows appear in console within ~20–30m after drain begins.

Emma: I'll tell customer: partial visibility in 30m, full reconciliation ~3h.

Priya: canary restart done. Logs show workers started and auth succeeded: 
```
2025-07-15T15:12:04Z INFO backfill-worker: authenticated as backfill-sa, starting drain
2025-07-15T15:12:07Z INFO backfill-worker: processing partition 12 offset 345678 -> throughput ~ 2200 msg/s
```

Raj: monitoring consumer lag and rollup writes. Adding runbook note: if SA rotation and cron coincide, backfill job should be paused until secrets updated.

DevOpsBot: ops-alert: post-rotation jobs identified: daily-repair, quota-recalc. Created issue INFRA-4321.

Jordan: Also noticed a schema mismatch warning in backfill about `rollup_window` type change from `int` to `bigint` in migrations at 2025-07-14. Worker tolerated it but logs a warning — not fatal. Leaving a note to confirm bincompat for older workers.

Priya: Action items: 1) update runbook to add secret-refresh gating for cron jobs (Priya) 2) backfill full drain and monitor for data reconciliation (Jordan) 3) customer comms (Emma) 4) postmortem and infra ticket (Raj/DevOps)

Emma: Customer updated: "Thanks — looking forward to the fix, please ping when heatmap returns."

Jordan: will post progress updates. Current backlog draining; expected partial rows in console at ~15:40Z.

Priya: rolling this to dedicated rollout channel after closure. Thanks all :thumbsup:

Emma: closing the loop — will follow up in 3h and move ticket to monitoring.

DevOpsBot: deploy-bot: INFRA-4321 assigned to priya, due 2025-07-22.

Raj: marking this thread as incident-candidate for postmortem.

Emma: 👍 thanks team
